## m446 (release #54; class number assigned at merge) — a trader that keeps trading on bars it has no reason to believe
- **Symptom:** the 2026-10-29 owner ruling ("a financial product, not a game - nothing related to data loss or incorrect data can continue to trade") exposed five holes in the bar path, each found on the real store (`data/data.db`, MNQ 12-26 / ES 12-26). (1) Two bad prints are stored `live` (rows 2020662, 2020732, 10-19 08:58 and 09:19: an 82 pt close the next bar opens 69 pt away from, and a 163 pt wick on a flat ES) and sit in every ATR / swing / level read since; the 27 bars over 60 pt in the last 7 days are all real news bars. (2) NT8's live 5m/3m/15m bar was BORN at the first live minute after the 08:34 reconnect on 10-27 (5m row 2045884, 3m row 2045706): open 43 pt and low 56 pt wrong, volume 5x short. Over 10-21/22/23 twelve more HTF bars disagree with their own 1m by 0.75-26.75 pt. (3) The 1m store has no row at all for MNQ 10-26 17:00-21:57 CT (ES has 240, MNQ 3m/5m/4h are there); the seed's 1m->1h->4h aggregation silently skipped that bucket, so the swing 4h EMA34 was 29645.53 against 29645.11 (0.42 pt) and the trade-recheck compared it with 29637.87, a recompute that included NT8's 94 off-grid stub 4h rows (the "7.7 pt gap" was the audit's error, not the bot's). (4) `evictForIngest` drops a FINAL-carrying frame when the queue holds only finals, `enqueueBarHistorical` drops a restart seed after 2 s, and a historical batch evicted as the "oldest" frame was counted as an intrabar drop-oldest; none recorded WHICH minutes were lost. (5) The ring is purged on a roll, but nothing asserted that the window, the AddOn's contract and the stored history agree.
- **Probe:** for every number a trade decision reads, ask what independent source holds the same fact (ES for a spike, the 1m for an HTF bar, the 5m for a 4h close, the AddOn's ACK for the contract) and whether anything compares them; for every `drop`/`skip`/`continue` on a data path, ask whether the lost item is recorded by identity (symbol, frame, open time) or only counted; for every aggregation, ask what it does with a bucket it cannot build (skip, or fail); when an audit reports "the bot is N pt off a recompute", rebuild the recompute from the bot's own input before believing the gap.
- **Rule:** a data-truth check pauses NEW entries only (never exits, stops, BE/trail, closes, protection, flatten), fails CLOSED when it cannot judge (error, panic, missing source, no data), alerts once per episode, and resumes only when the condition is MEASURED clear. A spike is real iff ES, volume or the next bar says so; a next bar that opens away from the close overrides ES (a restart replays the same stale series into both feeds). A drop site records the lost bars by identity; the loss clears only when the minute is present and closed. A hole in an indicator lookback is priced by its weight in the indicator (EMA k(1-k)^age, window 1/N), and the swing line is judged by its measured disagreement with the line rebuilt from every frame.
- **Reference:** m446 `fix/m446-data-truth-checks`; `internal/datatruth` (`Register`, `Evaluate`, `SetNotifier`, `HealthSnapshot`), `internal/datatruth/checks` (`SuspectBars`, `CompareFrames`, `JudgeSeries`, `JudgeSwing4h`, `Buckets4h`, `Ledger`, `JudgeContract`, `RegisterAll`), `provider/ninjatrader/datatruth_wire.go` (`noteIngestLoss`, `liveContracts`, `DataTruthSources`, `WireDataTruth`); pins `TestBadPrintRealNewsBarsNeverPause`, `TestBadPrintRealBadPrintsPause`, `TestBadPrintStale1014`, `TestCrossFrame1027RestartTruncatedBars`, `TestSwing4hP26Explained`, `TestJudgeSeriesWeightsAndUnits`, `TestIngestFinalDropPausesUntilMinuteVerified`, `TestIngestHistoricalEvictionIsLedgered`, `TestIngestHistoricalTimeoutIsLedgered`, `TestContractRollGuardThroughDrainAndObserve`, `TestDataTruthRealDayReplay1021_1023`, `TestDataTruthFullCorpusEpisodes`.
- **Known limits (not fixed):** the checks are registered and pinned standalone; the integrator wires `datatruth.Evaluate` into m445's single entry verdict and calls `WireDataTruth` / `datatruth.UseOwnerPush` at boot. The swing/levels checks need the store-backed 1m+5m history and the evaluator's live line from the trader (`SwingInputs`; the 2500-bar ring is too shallow). A lost FINAL clears when the forming bar is followed by a later bar, which proves the minute closed but not that its last ticks were kept. The seed still skips a 4h bucket it cannot build from the 1m (cure: fill the 1m from the re-request, or fall back to the 5m close; the check pauses instead when the gap exceeds 1 pt).

### m446 round 1 (review BACK on e4c04d616) — what the first draft got wrong, and the rule that follows
- **D1 a debt with no clearing path.** `Ledger.RecordLoss` ledgered a dropped message that carried no real bar (empty / placeholder-only `bars_historical`) as an "unknown" loss; the only clearer, `ClearUnknown`, had zero production callers, so MNQ was paused until restart. **Rule:** every debt a check can open must have a production caller that can close it on a MEASURED condition (grep the clearer's callers when you add the opener); a message that lost nothing owes nothing; the one debt not tied to a minute (ledger-cap overflow) is a (symbol, frame, from, to) range cleared by a whole-range verifier. Pins `TestIngestDropOfAMessageWithNoRealBarOwesNothing`, `TestIngestLedgerOverflowClearsWhenTheRangeIsWholeInTheRing`, `TestLedgerOverflowIsARangeClearedByWholeVerifier`.
- **D2 one rate-limit bucket for seven checks.** ownerpush buckets by the key prefix before `|`; every check shared `data_truth`, so a flapping `cross_frame` (29 episodes in 10 days, in bursts at the 15-minute cadence) starves `ingest_loss`. **Rule:** a new alert key's FIRST segment is its budget bucket - one per independent failure mode; a check that re-blocks within `ReopenMergeWindow` (30 min) of its own clear is the same episode. Pins `TestEachCheckHasItsOwnPushKind`, `TestFlappingCheckMergesIntoOneEpisode`.
- **D3 a tautology as a guard.** `contract_roll` with no `HistoryContract` reader compared the AddOn's ACK with its own live frames; `BarsHistoricalPayload.Contract` was parsed and dropped. **Rule:** a "differs from X" check must read X from a source independent of the thing it judges; "" is unknown, never a match. The seed's contract is now carried through `barIngestMsg` and `histContracts`. Pins `TestContractGuardSeesAnOldMonthSeedUnderNewMonthLiveFrames`, `TestContractGuardSeesAnOldMonthSeedOlderThanTheWindow` (the leg the window cannot see), `TestContractGuardBlocksWhenTheSeedNamesNoContract`.
- **D4 a pause that ends by age while the wrong bar is still read.** bad_print judged 30 minutes, cross_frame 12 (and a 15m bar is the newest 15m bar for 15). **Rule:** a known-wrong value clears when it is repaired/replaced or when its influence on every reader has decayed below that reader's tolerance (`HoldMinutes`: EMA weight k(1-k)^age, window 1/n) - never because time passed; a window is never shorter than the frame it judges. Pins `TestBadPrintHoldsWhileItStillInfluencesIndicators`, `TestBadPrintLongHoldFlagsOnlyTheRealBadPrints`, `TestCrossFrameHoldsWhileTheWrongBarInfluencesIndicators`, `TestCrossFrameJudgesAFrameForAtLeastItsOwnLength`.
- **D5 a registration that skips itself fails open.** `RegisterAll` silently skipped `ingest_loss` / swing / levels when their inputs were nil. **Rule:** the wiring declares the required set (`datatruth.Require`); a required name nobody registered is a stub that blocks and shows `blocked` on /api/health. Pins `TestRequiredButUnregisteredCheckBlocks`, `TestRegisterAllWithoutInputsLeavesRequiredChecksBlocking`, `TestWiringWithoutStoreReaderBlocksTheSwingChecks`.
- **D6 a cache that saves the cheap half.** swing and levels each did a full store read per Evaluate; the cache covered only the judgement. **Rule:** cache the read, key it by the clock bucket it is valid for. Pin `TestSwingInputsAreReadOncePerSymbolMinute`.
- **D7 lost-FINAL / aged-out.** Unchanged semantics (a later bar proves the minute closed, not that its last ticks were kept; a lost batch ages out of the 2500-bar ring after ~41 h of 1m), now with a hook: `DataTruthRerequest(symbol, tf, fromMs, toMs)` fires for every real FINAL/HISTORICAL loss so m444's hole re-request can fetch it. Pin `TestIngestLossFiresTheRerequestHook`.
- **Known limits (round 1):** past its hold a wrong bar is still in raw range reads (1h ranges, PDH/PDL); the real-day proof needs the local corpus `/tmp/datatruth-f7a/corpus_1019_1029.json.gz` (sha256 0a6f2a61e002d31769817c184e25b3353585f38c9f4a07d2bf47a673e7a74af5) - the committed fixtures (`testdata/*.json`, incl. `bad_1019_after.json`, rows from data.db) carry the pins that do not need it. On the "clean" days 10-21/22/23 cross_frame DOES pause (99 / 123 / 15 minutes): the pauses are the builder's own real HTF mismatches, not false alarms.

### m446 round 2 (review BACK on f7a978a73) — the lookback family had no check for the levels that never forget
- **D1 a decay model applied to a sum.** `indicator_lookback` prices a hole by its weight in an EMA / window (k(1-k)^age, 1/N), which is right for an indicator that forgets. The kernel also reads values that are SUMS over a whole session and never forget: session VWAP and its +-1/+-2 sigma bands, eVWAP (since the 15:00 CT cash close), pdVWAP, the prior-day profile (POC/VAH/VAL, hence naked POC) and MID-O (`kernel/levels_volume.go`). The 10-26 1m hole (17:02-22:37 CT) left 13% of the volume at 6 h: session VWAP from the 1m 29426.76 against 29499.05 from the 5m (-72 pt), -63 pt at 12 h, and on the next day the prior session read POC 29806.88 against 29553.12 restored (+254 pt), VAH +136, VAL +249, pdVWAP +18.9. Nothing paused on it except the EMA specs, which stopped after 5.5 h. **Probe:** for every level the kernel emits, ask whether it is a recurrence (forgets, price the hole by its weight) or a sum (never forgets, recompute it); list them from the code (`VolumeLevelsFor`), not from the spec table. **Rule:** a session-anchored sum is judged by RECOMPUTING it with the missing mass restored from an independent frame (per 5m slot max(0, V5 - sum of the 1m volumes), priced at the 5m typical price and spread over its [L, H] for the profile) and blocks when the level moves by more than its tolerance (VWAP and sigma 2 pt, profile rows 2.5 pt); a slot in neither frame is priced from the session median at the last known price, and a slot that cannot be priced at all blocks. The mirror of the SVP geometry lives in `checks` and is held to `kernel.SessionVWAPLevels` / `PriorDayProfileLevels` by a parity pin. Registered as its own required check `indicator_lookback_session`.
- **Reference:** `internal/datatruth/checks/session_volume.go` (`JudgeSessionVolume`, `JudgeSessionLevels`, `SVPProfile`, `ProfileOf`, `DefaultSessionVol`), `register.go` (`CheckLookbackSession`, `SessionLevelsCheck`), `scripts/datatruth_export_sessions.py`, fixture `testdata/sessions_vol.json` (MNQ 12-26 sessions 10-19, 10-21, 10-22, 10-26 with row ids; each carries the 24 h before it); pins `TestSessionVolumeHole1026Pauses`, `TestSessionVolumeProfilePausesAsPriorSession`, `TestSessionVolumeCleanSessionsNeverPause`, `TestSessionVolume1019Truncation`, `TestSessionVolumeFailsClosed`, `TestSessionLevelsCheckThroughEvaluate`, `TestSessionVolumeMirrorsKernelLevels` (provider/ninjatrader), the replay asserts in `TestDataTruthRealDayReplay1021_1023` / `TestDataTruthFullCorpusEpisodes`. Real defects found by it: rows 2022946 / 2022962 / 2022982 (5m, 10-19 21:15 / 21:20 / 21:25 CT: volume 10296 / 4797 / 5120) against the 1m rows 2022948-2022961 / 2022965-2022981 / 2022983-2023058 (volume 2355 / 1704 / 3462): session VWAP 2.9 pt off, sigma 2.3 pt; and 5m row 2027988 (10-21 00:35 CT, volume 300 against 5720 in the 1m) which makes the overnight low differ between frames for five minutes (MID-O).
- **Known limits (round 2, not fixed):** (a) volume levels of sessions older than the prior one (the naked POCs of earlier days) are not judged; they come from the stored-profile path. (b) A session whose 1m is wrong keeps the entry pause for the whole next session too - the prior session's pdVWAP/profile are read all day - until the store is repaired or the session after it begins; this is the cost of "nothing that is incorrect can trade" and the integrator may scope this one name to the entries that read those levels. (c) `ingest_loss` (D2): a lost FINAL clears when its minute is present and a later bar exists (it proves the minute closed, not that its last ticks were kept - the same semantics as the mentor's closed-bar read); a lost HISTORICAL batch also clears when its minutes are older than the ring's first bar, which conflates "never present" with "aged out" - making a full ring the aged-out proof would pause a symbol indefinitely when no re-request is wired, so `indicator_lookback` holds the shallow-ring case instead. (d) `ingest_loss` (D3): `bad bars_historical payload`, `bad bar_update payload` and `REJECTED bars_historical for unsubscribed symbol` drop a whole message with only a log line; the first two carry no symbol or minutes to ledger, the third is a symbol nobody subscribed to. They are not data the decision reads, and a malformed frame has no identity to owe. (e) `contract_roll` (D4): after a roll, a queued OLD-contract live frame drained after the tracker was reset re-notes the old contract and pauses entries for at most the 30-minute window; fail closed, rare.

## m447 (release #54; class number assigned at merge) — two views of one account that nothing compares; a price nobody checks against the market it printed in
- **Symptom (1):** the bot decides from its own picture (trader_positions, the armed_orders ledger, the pending map) and NT8 holds the truth; the reconcile compared the positions and healed them, but nothing paused NEW entries while the two disagreed, and the ORDER side was compared only at the flat gate and by the reaper. Real: `nt8_order_snapshots` 153026..153203 (SimAccount1, 2026-10-22 09:20:22-09:49:52 UTC) listed a SELL limit 29458.50 named `2cba226c-ecad-470a-90ad-b2313529c6d2` that no `armed_orders` row and no `trader_positions` row names, for 30 minutes; it then filled and position 687 was born from reconcile (source=reconcile, entry_order_id 3d77b26a), not from the bot. Armed rows 419 / 426 / 427 / 363 stayed `working` 16-87 minutes after their orders had left the book (427: position 686 was born from reconcile at 07:54:00 while the ledger said working until 09:16:59).
- **Symptom (2):** nothing judged a recorded fill price against the bars of the minute it printed in. A mis-parsed frame, a stale quote or a lost print in the bars would flow into entry price, stop distance and P&L unremarked.
- **Probe:** for every pair of views of one fact (bot row / broker position, ledger arm / broker order, bound account / account list) ask which side a disagreement is allowed to go unnoticed on, what settles an in-flight event, and who samples it when nothing is trying to trade; for every price the bot records, ask what independent source bounds it. Before calling a gate non-flapping, replay the persisted history it would have judged (here: 187 arm lifespans in the book had zero gaps; 74 "orders alive after the ledger said cancelled" were all pre-terminal presence - measure presence AFTER the state change).
- **Rule:** a disagreement pauses entries only after it has persisted a settle window taken from the code's own timing (the reconcile debounce 60 s = 2 x the 30 s order-snapshot period), is tracked per disagreement key and sampled on the reconcile loop (not at the entry attempt), reads through the reconcile's own helpers (`HeldBook`, the owner lookups, `reaperVerdictAt`, `ledgerExplainsPosition`) instead of a second reconcile, fails closed when it cannot compare, is not judged while the CME is closed, and never writes. A recorded fill is judged against the closed 1m bars of its own minute with a tolerance measured from reality (real worst case 1.0 pt outside the minute bar, 0 outside the window band); ONE far fill alerts once, the second in a session pauses entries until acknowledged or the next session. A forming bar is not evidence.
- **Reference:** m447 `fix/m447-broker-agreement`; `trader/broker_agreement.go` (`judgeAgreement`, `agreementTracker`, `RegisterBrokerAgreement`), `trader/ninjatrader/reconcile.go` (`HeldBook`, `SetReconcileObserver`, `ReconcileSettleMs`), `internal/datatruth/checks/fillprice.go` (`JudgeFill`, `FillGuard`), `trader/ninjatrader/fill_price_guard.go` (`NoteFill`), `api/handler_fillprice.go`; pins `TestBrokerAgreementUntrackedPositionPausesAfterSettle`, `TestBrokerAgreementOrphanRowPausesAfterSettle`, `TestBrokerAgreementQuantityDivergencePauses`, `TestBrokerAgreementRealUnknownBrokerOrderPauses`, `TestBrokerAgreementLedgerWorkingBrokerAbsentPauses`, `TestBrokerAgreementLedgerCancelledBrokerLivePauses`, `TestBrokerAgreementAccountBindingPauses`, `TestBrokerAgreementNoPositionsFrameFailsClosed`, `TestBrokerAgreementStaleBookFailsClosed`, `TestBrokerAgreementIsSampledByTheReconcilePass`, `TestBrokerAgreementIsReadOnly`, `TestFillPriceRealThirtyDaysNeverFires`, `TestFillPriceCorruptedRealFillsAreFar`, `TestFillGuardOneAlertThenPauseOnTheSecondThenAckOrNextSession`, `TestFillGuardOrderedExitFarPriceIsCountedAndAlertedButTheExitStillRecords`, `TestFillGuardEntryFillFrameFarPriceIsCountedAndTheFillStillRecords`, `TestArmedEntryFillFarPriceIsCountedAndTheFillStillMaterializes`.
- **Known limits (not fixed):** (a) the checks are registered and pinned standalone; the integrator calls `trader.RegisterBrokerTruthChecks()` at boot, may `datatruth.Require` both names, and wires `datatruth.Evaluate` into m445's verdict. (b) The first `Evaluate` after a disagreement began and before any reconcile pass (<=20 s) sees it for the first time; the settle clock starts there. (c) A broker book older than 120 s while the CME is open pauses entries (fail closed): 30 days of persisted snapshots show about 30 gaps of 121 s-10 min per account, mostly process restarts. (d) Positions: the reconcile compares per row; two traders sharing one account and symbol would read each other's quantity as a divergence (as the reconcile already does). (e) Orders: NT8's own "Close" orders, bracket children (-sl/-tp/-lx) and held-locally (Initialized) orders are not judged; a manual non-uuid order is not the bot's data to lose. (f) fill_price: a fill with no stored 1m bar and no order price is counted unjudged, not paused on; the reconcile's materialized rows (entry = NT8 average, time = materialization) are not judged as fills.

### m447 round 1 (review BACK on 9e9c6b5d0) — what the first draft got wrong, and the rule that follows
- **D1 one event, two reporters, two ids.** The AddOn's OnOrderUpdate sends an order_update AND a fill frame for ONE entry fill; the draft judged both (`materializeArmedEntry` `arm|...`, `handleFillInbound` `entry|...`), so one far fill read "2 of 2" and paused at once; the ids also carried `time.Now()` when the frame had no time, so a replay was a new fill. **Rule:** when two frames report one event, judge the one that carries the event's own time and give the id the broker's identity of the fill (account, symbol, signal, price, quantity), never the clock; the pin drives BOTH production paths in both orders. Pin `TestArmedEntryOneFillFromBothFramesIsCountedOnce`, `TestFillGuardReplayedFillFrameIsOneFillWhateverTheClock`.
- **D2 an acknowledgement that never expires.** `Ack` set `acked`, `apply` never cleared it, so no later far fill ever paused again. **Rule:** a manual override spends the evidence it saw, not the future; probe every latch for the event that re-arms it. Pins `TestFillGuardAckIsSpentByTheNextFarFill`, `TestFillGuardFarFillAfterAckPausesAgain`.
- **D3 sampling on a protective goroutine.** The reconcile observer ran in a defer on the `safe.GoNet` reconcile goroutine; a panic in a check froze the trader and ended the protective loop. **Rule:** a read-only observer riding a protective loop recovers its own panics. Pin `TestReconcileObserverPanicDoesNotEscapeTheReconcilePass`.
- **D4 a global swapped under leaked goroutines.** Tests assigned the package variable `checks.DefaultFills` while a fill consumer leaked by an earlier test still read it: a DATA RACE that failed `-race` 2 of 3 runs under TZ=UTC. **Rule:** a process-wide singleton that tests replace is an atomic pointer behind an accessor. `checks.DefaultFills()` / `SetDefaultFills`.
- **D5 a tracker mutant that survived.** Dropping a cleared key's first-seen time was untested, so a recurring disagreement would block with no settle. Pin `TestBrokerAgreementRecurringDisagreementGetsAFreshSettle`.
- **D6 a proof that covered less than it said.** "0 far in 30 days" judged trader_fills exits and trader_positions entries but not the price the bot RECORDED on a closed position; 2 of 95 (positions 635, 639: 31299.17 against real prints 31269.4, 31297.75 against 31272.75) are far and are true positives (wrong recorded price, later corrected). **Rule:** a real-data proof names every source of the quantity it claims about. Pin `TestFillPriceRecordedExitPricesOfTheLast30DaysFireOnlyTheTwoWrongOnes`.
- **Known limits (round 1):** an armed fill whose fill frame never arrives is not judged (the order_update twin carries no time to judge against); the AddOn sends the frame from the same handler, so this needs a lost frame.


### m447 round 2 (review BACK on 11032f217) — fail-closed branches nobody drove; an exemption wider than its reason
- **D1 a fail-closed branch with no pin is a fail-open branch waiting for a refactor.** `judgeAgreement` / `brokerAgreementInputs` turn every failed read (owner lookup, ledger lookup, position lookup, open-positions read, armed-ledger read) into "cannot judge" = block. Five mutants that replaced each `return ... cannotJudge(...)` with `continue` / `rows = nil` / `arms = nil` ("treat as agreeing") all survived: no test ever made a read fail. **Rule:** for every "cannot judge, so block" branch, a pin makes THAT read fail (an injected lookup error, or the throwaway test DB's table renamed - never dropped) and asserts the block through the production call site; and the control beside it (a merely NOT-FOUND ledger row is not an error). Pins `TestBrokerAgreementFailedLookupsFailClosed` (mutants ME, MF, MD, MK), `TestBrokerAgreementUnreadableStoresFailClosed` (MG, MH).
- **N1 an exemption must be as narrow as the reason it exists for.** "An entry was sent, its fill has not landed" excused an NT8 position the bot had no row for - but the test was `len(pending) > 0`, so ONE resting limit of either side (the C8 sweep keeps it pending for as long as it works at NT8, hours) hid every unexplained NT8 position. **Rule:** the exemption matches the held position's side; a pending entry whose side is not a side excuses nothing. `TCPTrader.PendingEntrySides()` carries the side `PendingEntries()` dropped. Pin `TestBrokerAgreementPendingEntryExcusesOnlyItsOwnSide` (mutants MI "exemption removed", MJ "any pending excuses"). Residual [B]: a same-side pending entry still excuses a same-side NT8 position with no row; a manual NT8 position opened while a bot limit of that side rests is hidden until the limit leaves pending.
- **N2 canonicalize where the value enters.** `FillGuard` keyed strikes by the raw symbol while the Ack handler upper-cased its query: a frame saying `mnq` or `MNQ 12-26` struck a key the gate never read, so the pause silently never came. **Rule:** one `checks.StrikeKey` (instrument root, upper-cased) used by `apply`, `Check` and `Ack`. Pin `TestFillGuardSymbolSpellingsShareOneStrikeCount` (mutant: raw symbol as key).
- **N3 a report that mislabels its own evidence.** Positions 635 and 639 exit_time are 1791371025596 = 2026-10-07 06:03 CT (11:03 UTC) and 1791441480228 = 2026-10-08 01:38 CT (06:38 UTC); round 1 wrote 11:03 CT and 06:38 CT. Ids and prices were right. **Rule:** a timestamp in a report names its zone and is derived from the epoch, not retyped.

### m446 round 3 (review BACK on 109635952) — three pins that did not guard, and an empty read that read as clean
- **D-A a path pinned only by a test that skips in CI.** The prior-session leg of `JudgeSessionLevels` (step 3: pdVWAP, POC/VAH/VAL, nPOC) was reached by no committed test: the existing prior-session pin called `JudgeSessionVolume` directly and the `Evaluate` pin read 10-26 at 23:00 (current session only). Deleting the step left every committed test green; only `TestDataTruthFullCorpusEpisodes` went red, and it `t.Skip`s without the `/tmp` corpus. **Rule:** a pin that skips on a missing local corpus is a replay, not a guard; every branch of a verdict function needs a committed pin that enters through the production call site (`datatruth.Evaluate` over `RegisterAll`), and the pin names what the branch says (`pdVWAP/profile of session 10-26`, `POC`, `VAH`, `VAL`). Run the deletion mutant of each branch. Pin `TestSessionLevelsPriorSessionThroughEvaluate` (10-26 hole read as the prior session at 10-27 17:30 and 10-28 08:00 CT, plus the clean 10-21 counterpart).
- **D-B a verdict cache with no test that the verdict MOVES.** `sessionLevelsCheck` memoises by (symbol, minute); keying it on minute 0 froze the first verdict forever (a clean one never paused again, a blocked one never cleared) and every committed test stayed green because they only ran four Evaluates inside one minute. **Rule:** a cache pin asserts the output changes when the input changes on the next key, in both directions (clean to hole, hole to clean), and counts the reads per key. Pin `TestSessionLevelsVerdictFollowsTheStore`.
- **D-C an empty read is not a clean read.** `JudgeSessionLevels` skips every window that holds no bar, so `(nil, nil)` with `err == nil` returned not-blocked; only `indicator_lookback_swing4h` happened to block an empty store, so the set failed closed by accident and would stop doing so the moment the integrator scoped this check apart from the swing one (the December roll: a store keyed to a contract with no rows yet). **Rule:** a check that reads a store judges the store's freshness first - an OPEN market with no stored 1m or 5m bar in the last two closed 5m slots is "cannot judge" and blocks; calendar silence (CME break, weekend, the first ten minutes after a reopen) is never read as loss. `storeSilent` returns false unless EVERY minute of its window was open. Pin `TestSessionLevelsFailClosedOnSilentStore` (empty store through `JudgeSessionLevels` and `Evaluate`, a store whose newest bar is 1 h old, and the closed/just-reopened cases that must not pause).
- **Known limit (not changed, owner ruling pending):** one unfilled 1m hole pauses entries for the whole session it sits in AND the whole next session that reads it as the prior session (10-26 17:06 to 10-28 15:59 CT, 2814 min). The pause follows the owner principle and clears by itself only when the store is repaired or the prior-session window rolls past the bad session.

### m447 round 3 (review BACK on 23d2af68f) — a reused answer that means the opposite here; a replacement that forgot who else was standing in the slot
- **D1 an answer reused outside the contract it was written for.** `ledgerExplainsPosition` answers `(reason, true)` when a ledger read fails - reconcile's "never flatten on a read error": for a caller that FLATTENS, "explained" is the safe side. `broker_agreement` reused it as "the ledger explains this NT8 position", so an unreadable Picture ledger excused `pos:untracked` and CLEARED a standing block (fail-OPEN; found by renaming `picture_htf_opportunities` after the block stood, the round-2 pins covered OwnerOf / ArmFor / PositionKnows / open-positions / armed only). **Rule:** a helper whose "true" means "stay out of the way" is fail-closed for a caller that destroys and fail-OPEN for a caller that pauses - when reusing it, read what ITS error path answers, and give the pausing caller its own error return (`ledgerExplainsPositionChecked`; `LedgerExplains` now returns `(bool, error)`, error -> `cannotJudge`). Reconcile's own wrapper is unchanged and pinned unchanged. **Pins:** `TestBrokerAgreementUnreadableLedgerKeepsAStandingBlock` (through `datatruth.Evaluate`: block stands, then the picture table is renamed, the block still stands and now says "cannot judge"), `TestLedgerExplainsPositionCheckedReportsUnreadable` (armed / picture / open-positions each surfaced), `TestBrokerAgreementFailedLookupsFailClosed/ledger-explains_read`. **Mutants RED:** MN (the closure drops the error), MO (the `lerr != nil` guard disabled).
- **D2 state keyed by a value the writer can send from the past.** `FillGuard.apply` replaced the whole `strikeState` whenever the fill's session differed from the stored one; a late or replayed exit receipt from the PREVIOUS session therefore wiped the standing pause's two strikes and `Check` read the new empty state as "next session: clear" (fail-OPEN). **Rule:** a "new session starts fresh" replacement needs a direction - only a fill NEWER than the state's newest fill may start a session; an older one is judged, counted and alerted (it is a real far print) but never touches the current session's strikes or an owner's acknowledgement. Direction is decided by the fill's own time (`strikeState.lastMs`), never by comparing session keys (they are opaque strings). **Pin:** `TestFillGuardLateFillFromAnOlderSessionDoesNotLiftAStandingPause` (pause stands after a previous-session far fill, acknowledgement survives a second, the next session still starts fresh strikes). **Mutant RED:** MP (`late := false`).
- **N1 a check on the exit-recording path with no recover.** `noteFill` runs inside `recordClose` / `recordCloseOrdered` and reaches the owner-alert callback; a panic there would have lost the exit record. `noteFill` now recovers and logs. **Pin:** `TestFillGuardPanickingAlertNeverCostsTheExitRecord` (real `recordCloseOrdered`, panicking alert sender, the position still closes). **Mutant RED:** MQ (recover disabled -> the test panics).
- **Re-checked, still fixed:** one armed entry fill (an `order_update` AND a fill frame) is counted once - `TestArmedEntryOneFillFromBothFramesIsCountedOnce` green, and the replayed-frame id stays clock-free (`TestFillGuardReplayedFillFrameIsOneFillWhateverTheClock`).
- **Known limits (round 3, recorded not fixed):** (a) the strike count and the fill_price pause live in memory only: a restart (kill -9 deploys) ends a standing pause with no acknowledgement. A far fill that is not repeated within one process lifetime does not pause. (b) The contract has no trader dimension: `brokerAgreementCheck` pauses the SYMBOL if any registered trader on it disagrees, so another account's problem (a second NT account's untracked position) pauses a healthy trader on the same symbol. Fail-closed by design; the episode names the account. (c) After a cannot-judge return `agreementTracker.apply` is skipped, so stale first-seen keys survive: a disagreement that clears and recurs inside that window blocks without a fresh settle. Still fail-closed. (d) `StrikeKey` canonicalizes the fill symbol, but `datatruth.Evaluate` keys its episodes by the raw symbol - that belongs to m446 and the integrator. (e) Owner expectation, not a bug: over the last 30 days arms 363, 426, 427 and 430 were `working` in the ledger but absent from NT8's book for 929 to 5040 s; they would have raised `ord:gone` and paused entries for up to 84 minutes. That is real ledger-vs-broker data loss.

## release #55 integration (class number assigned at merge) — a safety signal that is built and pinned standalone, and consulted by nobody
- **Symptom:** m446 (eight bar/ingest/contract checks) and m447 (broker agreement, fill price) shipped as `internal/datatruth` with their own pins and an explicit "the integrator wires `Evaluate` into the single entry verdict". Until that wiring a failing check paused nothing: a bad print stored `live` on 10-19 would still have fed every entry path.
- **Probe:** for every new detector/check package, grep who CALLS it outside its own tests (`grep -rn 'datatruth\.Evaluate' --include=*.go | grep -v _test`) and which boot function registers it; then list the entry paths (`data_integrity_gate.go` table) and ask each one: does the refusal text name this check?
- **Rule:** ONE verdict per symbol (`dataIntegrityVerdictAt`) joins every gate; a new gate is folded INTO that function, not added beside it, so every path consults it and exits (which never call it) stay free. The Require-then-Register pair makes a missing registration a blocking stub; a boot grace keeps the stubs from alerting on every restart. Gate-specific side effects (the m445 pause episode, resting-order withdraw) ask the narrower function, not the folded one. A scoped check (swing4h) is filtered by the window the asking path reads, never dropped.
- **Reference:** `trader/data_truth_gate.go` (`dataTruthVerdictAt`, `dataTruthReasons`, `wireDataTruthBoot`, `dataTruthBeat`), `trader/ninjatrader/datatruth_boot.go` (`WireDataTruthChecks`, `storeSwingInputs`), `api/handler_health.go` (`data_truth`, `trading_paused.data_truth_checks`); pins `TestDataTruthRefusesEntriesThroughAdmitEntry`, `TestDataTruthRefusesEveryAdmitPath`, `TestDataTruthRefusesMentorAuthoringAndTheArmedPass`, `TestDataTruthRefusesTheSIMTestSeams`, `TestDataTruthIsEntryOnly`, `TestDataTruthSwing4hScopesToSwingEntries`, `TestDataTruthUnwiredIsBlockedAndOnlyAlertsAfterTheBootGrace`, `TestDataTruthBeatRaisesTheEpisodeWithoutAnEntry`, `TestWireDataTruthBootDeclaresTheRequiredSetAndRegistersTheAccountChecks`, `TestWireDataTruthChecksRegistersAllEightAndSignalsReady`, `TestStoreSwingInputsReadsTheCurrentContractOneAndFiveMinute`, `TestHealthExposesDataTruth`.
- **Known limits (not fixed):** `DataTruthRerequest` is not wired (a lost seed batch clears when its minutes leave the 2500-bar ring, about 41 h, or the m444 hole tracker re-requests the minutes it sees missing in the store); the swing check is not coupled to the evaluator's live line (botLine 0: it compares the 1m-built line with the all-frames line from the same store); data truth does not withdraw resting entries; friend instances run the same gate (the owner push is a no-op without a bound chat).

## release #55 wave m449 (gate + tracker) — a release that another clock drives, a "ready" that precedes its data, an unknown that reads clean
- **Symptom:** (1) the gap audit's age-out (7 CME sessions) removed an unfilled retired hole from the tracker, so the m445 verdict went clear while the minutes were still missing and still inside the deep (~8.7 sessions), swing4h (~18) and mentor key-level (90 d) windows; (2) the m446 checks were "ready" the instant they were registered, seconds BEFORE the AddOn replay and the store rehydrate, so every restart judged an empty ring and pushed the owner; (3) m446 used `kernel.IsCMEOpen` while m445 used `barHoleExpected`, so the evening before Thanksgiving / Christmas / New Year's Day paused entries (and kept pausing after the reopen); (4) `ntwire.DataTruthRerequest` was never assigned, so ingest_loss had no remedy; (5) the mentor seeded-series leg read CLEAR when no seed had been measured.
- **Probe:** for every place that REMOVES a hole/episode/ledger entry ask which clock removes it and whether that clock is the one the READER uses (`grep -n removeLocked`); for every "ready"/"wired" edge ask what data it precedes (is it set after the data landed, or after the code registered?); for every pair of gates ask whether they share ONE calendar function; for every `var Hook func` ask who assigns it outside tests; for every verdict leg that reads a measurement ask what it returns when nothing was measured (`judged` false must be BLOCKED, never an empty list).
- **Rule:** aging may drop a hole only once it is outside EVERY window a decision reads - a watcher's own horizon is not the gate's; a gate waits for its data (blocked, quietly, with a deadline after which it speaks) and is "ready" only when the data landed; one calendar (`kernel.IsCMETradingExpected`) for every data gate; an exported hook has a production assignment and a pin that it is non-nil after boot; an unmeasured input is unknown = blocked; an empty read is not a measurement.
- **Reference:** m449 `fix/m449-gate-tracker`: `trader/ninjatrader/bar_gap_audit.go` (`applyAuditLocked` age-out retains), `trader/ninjatrader/datatruth_boot.go` (`DataTruthJudgeable`, `MarkDataTruthSeeded`, called from the boot entry `rehydrateRingFromStore`), `trader/data_truth_gate.go` (`dataTruthStarting`, grace 10 min), `kernel/cme_expected.go`, `trader/ninjatrader/datatruth_rerequest.go`, `trader/data_integrity_seed.go` (`seedSeriesVerdict` judged leg). Pins: `TestAuditAgeOutKeepsAnUnfilledHoleInTheGate`, `TestDataTruthWaitsForTheSeedQuietly`, `TestDataTruthOpenIsTheExpectedTradingCalendar`, `TestIngestLossHookIsWiredByTheBootWiring`, `TestUnmeasuredSeedSeriesBlocksMentorEntries`.
- **Known limits (not fixed):** whether the market really trades the holiday-eve evenings (the DB shows 419 real bars on the Good Friday eve, Thu 04-02) is not settled - both gates now agree on the calendar's answer and neither pauses there; a hole on a contract the platform has rolled away from is ignored by the verdict (`integrity()` skips another contract's holes), so step-0 of `collectDue` does not retain it; the seed edge is opened once per process (a mid-session AddOn reconnect re-replays into a live ring and is not re-gated).

## m450 (release #55; class number assigned at merge) — a calendar-derived grid that is only right on ordinary days, a check that judges a narrower series than the code it guards, a cache keyed by the clock instead of the data, and a hold priced by the widest reader
- **Symptoms (all found by the release #55 review, each reproduced or measured on the stored tape):**
  1. **DST grid.** `checks.Buckets4h` stepped `s + 4h` and tested "open for one of its minutes" on a DST day, where the 17:00-CT anchors are 23 or 25 hours apart. On Sun 2026-11-01 (and Sun 2027-03-14) it returned a bucket (22:00Z / 19:00Z) whose open probe fell in the NEXT grid's first hour, but every real bar maps to the next bucket - so the phantom bucket held no data in any frame and `JudgeSwing4h` called it unrepairable for the whole 113-bucket warm-up (about 26 days of SWING4H pause on a perfect feed). The old pin passed `open=nil` and a 24/7 series, so it could not see it.
  2. **Wrong series.** `storeSwingInputs` read the CURRENT contract only; the evaluator seeds from the contract-STITCHED series. After a roll the check paused SWING4H for days ("only 14 buckets" on 09-11, then "8 buckets exist in no frame" until 10-06 on the real 12-26 rows) although the series the strategy reads was complete.
  3. **Cache by clock.** `swingCheck` cached its verdict per 4h bucket; an owner repair ("read back within a minute") did not lift a blocking verdict for up to four hours.
  4. **Hold priced by the widest reader.** `HoldMinutes` charged the whole high/low excursion to every spec: a 163 pt wick that closes 7.5 pt from the next open was priced as a 163 pt CLOSE error against EMA/RSI/MACD (hold 245 min, one episode 266 min); the AI-path 3m/5m specs were charged to mentor traders, who read the 1m ring and one native 5m.
  5. **Immaterial pauses.** cross_frame paused 12-15 min on tick-skew of 0.75-2 pt (141 exclusive minutes over 10-14..10-29) and 90 min overnight on a 15m volume-only difference no indicator reads (175 exclusive minutes).
  6. **Unknown read as clear.** `levelsCheck` fell off its 5-session loop with `return false` when neither frame held a bar.
  7. **(review round 1, finding 1) Window arithmetic that assumes the two frames fill together.** `stitchedBarRows` fetched the older contract's 5m with `N - len(r5)`: once the NEW contract's 5m ring was full (5400 rows) while its 1m was still short, that was 0 rows, and the later `rowsAfter(r5, last 1m)` cut dropped every newer 5m row at or before the older's last bar - the independent 5m frame lost data that exists in BOTH contracts and SWING4H paused ("1 bucket inside the warm-up exist in no frame", real instance MNQ 09-26 / 12-26 at 2026-10-07 14:10 CT, bucket 2026-09-11 01:00 CT). The fixture never reached "5m ring full, 1m short". Fix: fetch the older 5m with a full N. Pin `TestSwing4hKeepsTheOlderFiveMinuteWhenTheNewFiveMinuteRingIsFull` (mutant R2: `N-len(r5)` -> RED with the reviewer's exact message).
  8. **(review round 1, finding 2) A reader's hold must price every field THAT reader reads.** F1 priced the mentor on the 1m EMA close only, so a 163 pt wick that closes back was a 6 minute (30 minute floor) event for it, but the mentor ALSO consumes raw 1m highs and lows (day gate Globex hi/lo, rolling PHL, boxes, trendline touches, the 3m/5m/15m candles filters.go builds from the 1m). New spec kind `SeriesSpec.Extreme` (`mentor_range_1m`, Reader mentor, Period `MentorRangeReadMin` = the 8 h cap): a raw max/min takes an error at FULL weight for the whole window, only the range error reaches it (`BarError.RangeErr`), above `ImpactTolPts`. It prices a WRONG bar only (`lookbackCheck` skips it; a hole in the 1m is the EMA spec's). Both 10-19 bad prints now hold the mentor reader until the cap (corpus: bad_print/mentor 10-19 08:58 -> 17:18) while the AI path still releases at ~75 min. Cost accepted: one wrong print can pause a mentor trader 8 h; the alternative (30 min) let a wrong session extreme keep trading.
  9. **(review round 1, finding 3) Presence of what a reader reads.** The mentor strong-day test reads the LAST 12 NATIVE 5m bars (`trader/mentor_tick.go` FuturesBarsProvider("MNQ","5m",12)) but every 5m lookback spec was `Reader: ai`, and `CompareFrames` never iterates a missing HTF bar: a lost native 5m bar paused the AI reader only and the mentor's strong-day flag silently evaluated false. New `mentor_strongday_5m` (Period 12, MaxWeight 0.05 < 1/12: a single lost bar pauses; `PresenceOnly`: it contributes no value-error hold - the range flip stays CompareFrames'). `TestLookbackNamesTheReadersOfTheHole` now pins: empty 3m ring = AI only; empty native 5m ring or one lost 5m bar in the last 12 = the mentor too.
- **Probe:** (a) any grid derived from a wall-clock anchor: run it with the REAL calendar over BOTH DST changes on a gap-free series and assert zero empty buckets; (b) for any check that guards a computation, list the exact series that computation reads and make the check read the same one (stitched vs current-contract, ring vs store); (c) a cache key must contain the data it caches (a fingerprint), never only the clock; (d) a hold/tolerance must be priced per reader and per FIELD an indicator reads (close vs range), not per worst number; (e) every "return false/clear" at the end of a loop that found nothing.
- **Rule:** a record threshold and a pause threshold are different numbers (`PriceTol` 0.5 pt records and counts via `datatruth.Count`; `PauseTol` = `ImpactTolPts` 2 pt pauses); an immaterial record is COUNTED (visible in /api/health `counted`), never silently dropped and never paused. A scoped check names its readers (`datatruth.RegisterScoped`, `Reason.Readers`); an unscoped check, an error and a panic concern everyone; the trader obeys only the reasons that name its own reader (`dataTruthReaderFor(openMin)`). Mirrors of mentor constants the checks cannot import (`StrongDayPts` 50, `MentorStrongDayBars` 12) are pinned against the evaluator source in `trader/`.
- **F3 verdict (10-29 08:15-08:30 CT):** NOT an artifact. The 1m is complete, the native 3m/5m/15m (rows 2058086-2058088) are snapshots that stop at ~08:27 (5m close 28.5 pt off, volume 6523 vs 15501; the ingest queue was pinned at 4096/4096 dropping intrabar frames), so the AI path pauses 08:30-09:44 correctly; the mentor is paused only because the 5m range (28.0 native vs 54.5 built) flips its strong-day test, to 09:29. Follow-up not done here: repair the native bars from the 1m (the pause would then clear by repair, not time).
- **Reference:** `internal/datatruth/checks/{lookback.go (Buckets4h, SeriesSpec.Range/Reader), hold.go (BarError, HoldMinutesFor), badprint.go (Suspect.CloseErr/Readers), crossframe.go (PauseTol, VolPauseTFs, StrongDayPts, countImmaterial), register.go (barsSig, swingCheck, levelsCheck, unionReaders)}`, `internal/datatruth/datatruth.go` (`RegisterScoped`, `Reason.Readers/Concerns`, `Count`), `trader/ninjatrader/datatruth_boot.go` (`stitchedBarRows`), `trader/data_truth_gate.go` (`dataTruthReaderFor`); pins `TestBuckets4hDSTRealCalendar`, `TestSwing4hJudgesTheStitchedSeriesAcrossARoll`, `TestSwing4hStillPausesOnARealHoleAcrossARoll`, `TestSwing4hRepairLiftsThePauseWithinTheSameBucket`, `TestLevelsCheckFailsClosedOnAnEmptyStore`, `TestBadPrintHoldsWhileItStillInfluencesIndicators`, `TestCrossFrameTickSkewIsCountedNotPaused`, `TestCrossFrame15mVolumeOnlyIsCountedNotPaused`, `TestCrossFrame1029OpenTruncationScopesToReaders`, `TestCrossFrameMentorIsOnlyHeldByAStrongDayFlip`, `TestLookbackNamesTheReadersOfTheHole`, `TestScopedChecksCarryTheirReaders`, `TestCountIsIdempotentPerKeyAndVisible`, `TestDataTruthScopesToTheReadersOfTheBadData`, `TestCrossFrameMentorConstantsMirrorTheEvaluator`, `TestSwing4hKeepsTheOlderFiveMinuteWhenTheNewFiveMinuteRingIsFull`, `BenchmarkSwingVerdictFullWindow` (swing re-judge cost: about 1.7 ms per symbol-minute at the full 25861 + 5173-row window; the verdict is re-judged on every new 1m bar, not per 4h bucket); the corpus replays (`TestDataTruthRealDayReplay1021_1023`, `TestDataTruthFullCorpusEpisodes`) now inject the refilled 10-26 hole into the fixture (`punch1mHole`) instead of depending on the store keeping it broken.
- **Known limits (not fixed):** the native HTF bars are not repaired from the 1m (the pause clears by time/influence decay, not repair); the stitch shifts the older contract by ONE seam difference (the newer close at the older's last bar), not the evaluator's measured 1h roll gap - a constant offset cancels in the line-vs-repaired comparison but a bucket straddling the seam carries the seam's real price move; the m446 checks use `kernel.IsCMEOpen` while m445 uses `barHoleExpected` (they disagree on the evenings of 11-25, 12-24 and 12-31: not changed here); the AI path's own raw high/low ranges past its hold (PDH/PDL, 1h ranges) are judged only as the prior session by the swing / levels checks.

## release #55 m451 (class number assigned at merge) — a per-symbol contract applied to per-account facts; one print counted per frame; a pause that forgets across a bell or a kill -9
- **Symptom:** `broker_agreement` and `fill_price` were registered as per-symbol `datatruth.CheckFn`s, so account A's stale order book, unknown order or quantity mismatch (or two far fills on A) paused entries for traders B and C on independent accounts; one far print arriving as 2-4 frames (bracket legs, partials, mirrored accounts) counted as 2-4 strikes, so the first far print paused although the guide says the second does; the broker tracker forgot every standing disagreement at each CME-closed tick (a 60 s fail-open at each reopen) and on the "entry just landed" call; the fill_price strikes and the owner's acknowledgement lived in memory only (a kill -9 deploy lifted a standing pause); `price <= 0` / `time <= 0` fills were silently ignored; the pause text for a quantity mismatch named no remedy that works (`/api/risk/clear-freeze` does not lift it).
- **Probe:** for every check, ask WHOSE fact it is (symbol data, or one account's/trader's view) and whether the block is scoped to that owner; for every counter that triggers a pause, ask what one real-world event is and whether two reporters of it add twice (key by the event, not the frame); for every "not judged now" branch (market closed, entry in flight) ask whether it forgets the standing state or only declines to measure; for every latch ask whether a kill -9 drops it (persist with an atomic file beside the DB); for every `if x <= 0 { return }` before a guard ask whether the bad value IS the finding; for every owner-facing remedy run it: does it actually lift the pause?
- **Rule:** a block carries its scope (`datatruth.ScopedCheckFn`: trader/account tokens; empty = the symbol; an error or panic is always the symbol) and the asking path filters by it (`Reason.AppliesTo`); a trader not under the check is not admitted on the others' silence; strikes are keyed (symbol, account) and counted per `FillObs.Event`; "not measured" never means "cleared" (`agreementTracker.standing`, `hold`); state that decides a pause is written atomically on every change (`FillGuard.EnableState`); a malformed record is counted as the bad data it is; a registry removal is a compare-and-delete.
- **Reference:** m451 `fix/m451-broker-truth`; `internal/datatruth/datatruth.go` (`RegisterScoped`, `Reason.AppliesTo`, `Wired`), `internal/datatruth/checks/fillprice.go` (`FillObs.Event/Account`, `CheckScoped`, `AckAccount`, `EnableState`), `trader/broker_agreement.go` (`agreementTracker.apply/standing`, `agreementRemedy`, `brokerAgreementCheck`, `unregisterBrokerAgreement`), `trader/data_truth_gate.go` (`dataTruthReasons`, `truthAsker`), `trader/ninjatrader/fill_price_guard.go` (`entryFillEvent`, `exitFillEvent`); pins `TestM451*` in `trader/broker_truth_m451_test.go`, `trader/ninjatrader/fill_price_event_m451_test.go`, `internal/datatruth/checks/fillprice_m451_test.go`, `internal/datatruth/scoped_m451_test.go`.
- **Known limits (not fixed):** a restart of the TRADER (not the process) still starts a fresh broker tracker, so its disagreements get a new 60 s window; a pending (not yet judged) fill is not persisted; the dashboard banner still reads TRADING PAUSED for every trader (the health `data_truth_scopes` field names who the block is for; a banner change is a web wave).


## release #55 m452 (class number assigned at merge) — a gate wired and pinned function by function, with the CALL that switches it on pinned by nothing
- **Symptom:** the #55 review deleted, in turn, `wireDataTruthBoot()` (NewAutoTrader), `at.dataTruthBeat(now)` (monitorTick) and `WireDataTruthChecks(bh, server)` (bar_persist_wire.go): `go test ./trader` stayed green every time. Every data-truth pin called the function directly, so the gate that the owner's rule rests on ("nothing related to data loss can continue to trade") could be switched off by a one-line deletion with no log, push or counter - failing OPEN. A fourth call (`registerBrokerAgreement`) was "pinned" by `strings.Index`, which a `//` comment satisfies. A fifth pin banned an entry-method name that does not exist, so the two real placers passed.
- **Probe:** for every safety gate, list the ONE production call that switches it on and the ONE that advances it (`grep -n 'wireX\|X(' <boot file>`), then comment each out and run the package: if nothing goes RED the gate is unpinned. Read call sites through `go/parser` (a comment is not an AST node), never `strings.Index`. For every name on a ban list, assert the name resolves to a declared symbol.
- **Rule:** a gate is pinned at its SWITCH-ON call site (AST: live, in the right function, under no `if` that can be false in production) and at its beat (drive the production tick, not the beat function); an exit-side census (`TestDataVerdictIsConsultedOnlyByTheEntryChain`) lists every function that may ask the verdict and fails on a new one. The switch-on never sits under a guard the gate's inputs can fail (`if st != nil` made the whole m446/m447 leg inert for a store-less trader).
- **Order:** work that reads a store (the episode beats) runs AFTER protection, flatten and EOD in `monitorTick`, bounded by a budget on its own goroutine with one beat in flight. A verdict asked at the head of a multi-second path is asked again at the wire.
- **Noise:** a request larger than the ring is structural, not a defect - count it under its own arm (`beyond_ring`), say it once per boot at INFO; and a counter is bumped AFTER the grace check, not before (the live #54 boot showed 21,953 short/empty counts in 2.6 min, about 500x the #53 rate, because the grace silenced the line but not the numbers). Owner-push budgets are per trader: the kind (text before the first `|`) carries the trader id.
- **Reference:** `trader/data_gate_wiring_pin_test.go`, `trader/ninjatrader/data_gate_wiring_pin_test.go`, `trader/data_beats_bounded.go`, `internal/datatruth/checks/register.go` (`cachedInputs`, `WarmSwingInputs`), `trader/ninjatrader/bar_horizon_warn.go`, `api/data_integrity_debug_door_test.go`.
- **Known limits (not changed):** the 4148-vs-4149 'deep re-request' count in the m444 hole line is the same number sized one minute apart (planned 15:38:08, sent 15:39:08; `deepBarsBack` is recomputed at every send), not a count error; `kernel.OpenIntervalsBetween` was probed on contiguous 1m/5m/15m/1h/4h/1d/1w tapes across weekends and the daily break and returns 0 gaps for each. The hot 4h/1d/1w caller that drove the live counter at ~44/s after the #54 boot was not traced to a loop (counters now stop counting graced reads; a rate above ~100/min after the grace is the next probe). `TestDataTruthFullCorpusEpisodes` still depends on a /tmp corpus and skips in CI.

## release #55 fix-round integration (class number assigned at merge) — two branches widen the same signature in two ways; a fixture that matches the old checks passes the new ones by accident
- **Symptom:** m450 (readers: WHICH entry path a block concerns) and m451 (scopes: WHICH trader/account it is for) each added a fourth return to `datatruth.ScopedCheckFn`, with different meanings and different consumers, in the same hunks of `internal/datatruth/datatruth.go` and `trader/data_truth_gate.go`; and m449's holiday-eve fixture seeded OPEN-stamped bars into `SeedHistorical` (which takes NT8's CLOSE-stamped frames), a one-bucket shift that the price-tolerant EMA/RSI specs could not see on a flat tape but m450's strict presence read of the last 12 native 5m bars (`mentor_strongday_5m`) did.
- **Probe:** when two waves widen one signature, grep every producer and every consumer of BOTH meanings and run the merged head's FULL suite, not each branch's (A27: a branch green alone is not green merged); for a fixture that feeds a cache, check the stamp convention it enters at (`openStampBars`) and that a check which can see the shift is in the pin (a flat price tape hides it).
- **Rule:** one returned `[]string` carries both kinds, told apart by shape (plain name = reader, `trader:`/`acct:` = scope; `splitTokens`); `Evaluate` puts them on `Reason.Readers` / `Reason.Scopes`; `dataTruthReasons` obeys BOTH filters; an error or panic loses both (blocks every trader on every path). Fixtures seed the cache the way the AddOn does (close-stamped).
- **Reference:** `internal/datatruth/datatruth.go` (`splitTokens`, `runCheck`), `trader/data_truth_gate.go` (`dataTruthReasons`). Pins: `TestScopedTokensSplitIntoReadersAndScopes`, `TestDataTruthReasonsHonoursReaderAndScopeTogether`, `TestGapFreeDataAroundAHolidayEveDoesNotPauseTheLookbackChecks` (close-stamped seed; its m449 mutant, Open back to `IsCMEOpen`, is still RED).

## release #55 round 3 h1 (class number assigned at merge) — a new automatic remedy that calls the wire directly skips the admission its sibling is built around
- **Symptom:** the m449 `ingest_loss` re-request hook called `RequestGapBackfillAt` / `RequestDeepGapBackfillAt` the instant the ingest queue dropped a batch. The m444 hole tracker sends only in the first 15 s of a CT minute (a re-request makes the AddOn rebuild its BarsRequests, a 20-35 s freeze of the forming bars; a freeze that crosses a minute boundary stores that 1m candle truncated, as LIVE) and never while the link, feed or CME is down. A drop under load fires at a random second, so a third to a half of the sends could write a truncated live candle - the remedy for lost data created wrong data. Separately the ingest_loss pause text and guide said "within the same daily budget" and nothing about the budget being spent (the pause then stands; nothing more is asked).
- **Probe:** for every new caller of a wire send, list the callers that already exist and every rule THEY apply before the send (`grep -n 'RequestGapBackfillAt\|RequestDeepGapBackfillAt'`); a rule that lives in the caller and not in the callee is a rule the new caller does not have. Run the new caller at second :40 with a fake wire. For every owner-facing remedy text, ask what happens when the thing it names is exhausted.
- **Rule:** automatic re-requests share ONE admission: `reRequestGateReason` (link, feed, CME open; a missing calendar refuses) + `barHoleInSendWindow` (send timing), then the wire's own spacing and per-session-day budget. A "not now" DEFERS (to the next window, or a slow poll while down) and never drops or sends out of turn. Drops are coalesced per symbol+frame into one chain whose span widens (hundreds of drops under queue pressure must not mean hundreds of timers). A spent budget is said once, not retried in a loop, and frees the chain. The pause text (`checks.IngestLossClearsText`) and the guide name all exits: bars back in the ring, the minute ageing out of the ring, a bot restart.
- **Pins:** `TestIngestLossHookWaitsForTheSendWindow`, `TestIngestLossHookSendsInsideTheWindow`, `TestIngestLossHookDefersWhileLinkFeedOrMarketIsDown`, `TestIngestLossHookCoalescesDropsIntoOneChain`, `TestIngestLossHookSpentBudgetIsNotRetriedAndFreesTheChain`, `TestRerequestAdmissionIsOneFunction` (go/parser), `TestRerequestGateReasons`, `TestJudgePauseTextNamesWhatClearsIt`, web `m55r3IngestLossGuide.test.ts`.
- **Reference:** `trader/ninjatrader/datatruth_rerequest.go`, `trader/ninjatrader/bar_holes.go` (`reRequestGateReason`, `gateLocked`, `barHoleInSendWindow`), `internal/datatruth/checks/ingestloss.go` (`IngestLossClearsText`).
- **Known limits (not changed):** a spent budget is not retried after the 17:00 CT roll by this hook (the chain ends; the tracker/audit still look for 1m holes in the store); a drop widening a chain while its send is in flight is covered by the standard replay but not by a deeper ask already sized; the restart remedy rests on NT8's replay plus the gap audit's first pass re-detecting a minute that never reached the store [B, audit first pass read, not run live].

## release #55 round 3 h2 (class number assigned at merge) — a guard that cannot read its own memory admits and then overwrites it; disk waits on the exit path; a scope token nobody matches; a boot call pinned by nothing
- **Symptom:** (1) `FillGuard.EnableState` treated an unreadable `*.fillprice.json` (read error, bad JSON, unknown version) as "start empty", then `persist()` overwrote the file with an empty state: a standing far-fill pause could not be told from none, entries were admitted, and the evidence was destroyed. (2) `apply` fsynced that file inline under a lock in the exit-RECORDING path (`recordClose`/`recordCloseOrdered` -> `noteFill` -> `Record`), so a stalled disk stalled the ordered worker and every frame queued behind it. (3) A reader or scope token that no consumer matches (`Mentor`, `ai:x`, `trader:`, `acct:`) made `Concerns`/`AppliesTo` return false for everyone: `Evaluate` announced "new entries PAUSED" while every door admitted. (4) Deleting `trader.SetFillPriceStatePath(cfg.DBPath + ".fillprice.json")` from `main.go` passed every suite (the restart pin calls the setter itself).
- **Probe:** for every persisted guard, truncate its state file and boot it: the answer must be BLOCKED, with the original bytes still on disk under another name. For every `persist()`/`Sync()`/`Write` reachable from an exit handler, make the target a FIFO (or any stalled path) and run the production handler with a deadline. For every token vocabulary a producer returns and a consumer matches, feed the consumer a token it does not know. For every boot setter, delete it from `main.go` and run `go test .`.
- **Rule:** unreadable state = a block for every symbol until the owner acknowledges (persisted in the fresh file so a second restart cannot lift it); the unreadable file is MOVED to `<path>.bad-<utc>` (never deleted, never overwritten; if it cannot be moved nothing is written over it and the block is memory-only). State writes are queued to one ordered, coalescing writer (`persist` only snapshots; `Flush` is for owner actions, boot and tests): an exit never waits on disk. An unrecognised reader/scope token applies to EVERYONE (a scope may only narrow to a recognised reader, trader or account). A boot setter is pinned by an AST test of `main()` (unconditional, top level, after the DB-path override, before `LoadTradersFromStore`).
- **Reference:** `internal/datatruth/checks/fillprice.go` (`EnableState`, `moveAside`, `persist`, `drain`, `Flush`, `unreadableState`), `internal/datatruth/datatruth.go` (`Concerns`, `AppliesTo`, `knownReader`, `knownScope`). Pins: `TestFillPriceUnreadableStateBlocksEntriesAndIsMovedAsideNotOverwritten`, `TestFillPriceUnreadableStateThatCannotBeMovedIsNeverWrittenOver`, `TestFillGuardExitRecordingNeverWaitsOnTheStateFileWrite`, `TestFillGuardRecordNeverBlocksOnAStalledStateWriteAndTheLatestSnapshotLands`, `TestDataTruthUnknownReaderOrScopeTokenAppliesToEveryone`, `TestMainSetsTheFillPriceStatePathBeforeTradersLoad`.
- **Known limits (not fixed):** a kill -9 in the few milliseconds between a far fill and its queued write forgets that strike (it was inline before; the exit is the priority); `RegisterBrokerTruthChecks()` in `doWireDataTruthBoot` is still unpinned by name (review lens 5 defect 1 - not this group's); the unreadable-state block is per symbol and needs one ack per symbol traded.

## release #55 round 4 h1 (class number assigned at merge) — a retry chain whose every exit is not pinned is a chain that can wedge, and a success that closes over a span widened mid-flight forgets the new loss
- **Symptom:** the m55r3 ingest_loss re-request pinned the admission and ONE chain exit (a spent budget). A mutant that dropped `finish()` after a successful send, on the "beyond the deepest ask" branch, on the 72 h give-up, or on the refused branch, and one that never counted `retries`, all stayed green. A chain left in `pending["MNQ|1m"]` swallows every later drop (it only widens the dead entry), so the pause stood until the minute left the ring (about 41 h) or a restart: the original m449 defect. Separately, a drop that widened the span after an attempt read it was closed over by that attempt's `finish()`: those bars were never asked for.
- **Probe:** for every coalescing/retry chain, list every exit (success, each refusal, give-up, out-of-range, retry cap) and for EACH one drop a second event afterwards and assert a NEW action starts; comment out each `finish()`/cleanup in turn. For every "close on success", ask what arrived between the read of the input and the close (a generation counter, not a re-read of the same fields).
- **Rule:** every terminal outcome frees the chain; a success frees it only when no later drop widened the span since the attempt read it (`dtRerequestSpan.gen`); otherwise it asks again for the wider span after the wire's spacing, with a fresh retry count. A TOO-SOON refusal is retried exactly `dataTruthRerequestMaxRetries` times and then closed.
- **Pins:** `TestIngestLossChainIsFreedAfterASuccessfulSend`, `...AfterBeyondTheDeepestAsk`, `...AfterTheGiveUp`, `...AfterARefusal`, `TestIngestLossTooSoonRetryCap`, `TestIngestLossSpanWidenedWhileSendingIsAskedForAgain` (both edges), `...WidenedFromMsOnlyIsAskedForAgain`, `...WidenedToMsOnlyIsAskedForAgain` (one edge each - the both-edges test cannot tell the two `gen++` arms apart), `TestIngestLossWidenedChainGetsFreshRetries` (`trader/ninjatrader/datatruth_rerequest_lifecycle_test.go`); web `m55r3IngestLossGuide.test.ts`. Mutants L1-L9 (see the file header; L7 no `gen++` on the newer-toMs arm, L8 none on the older-fromMs arm, L9 no `retries = 0` on the widened branch) each RED.
- **Reference:** `trader/ninjatrader/datatruth_rerequest.go` (`chain`, `finish`, `dtRerequestSpan.gen`).
- **Known limits (not changed):** a spent budget is still not retried after the 17:00 CT roll by this hook (the chain ends; the pause text and the log say so and name the exits); a drop that does not WIDEN the span (the same or a narrower one) landing inside the in-flight window of a send is not re-asked by that chain; the same span dropped again AFTER the chain finished starts a new chain as normal.

## release #55 round 4 h2 (class number assigned at merge) — moving a corrupt state file aside must never leave the path empty; an ack that "worked" but is not on disk; a remedy the next write undoes
- **Symptom:** (1) `EnableState` renamed an unreadable `*.fillprice.json` to `.bad-<utc>` and only THEN queued the replacement carrying the block. A crash, a full disk or a failed write in between left NO file at the path; the next boot read "no file" = no pause, and the owner who was told "entries are PAUSED until you acknowledge" was silently un-paused by a restart (a deploy is a kill -9). (2) `POST /api/risk/ack-fill-price` answered `acknowledged:true` even when the bounded flush timed out and the ack was not on disk. (3) The pause text offered "restore a repaired copy of the state file", which the very next strike or ack write overwrites.
- **Probe:** for every "move the bad file aside, then write a fresh one" sequence, fail the write (a directory in the temp name's place, `ulimit -f 0`, a FIFO) and boot again: the answer must still be BLOCKED. For every owner-action reply, stall the disk and read what it claims. For every remedy sentence in a pause text, run it.
- **Rule:** replacement first (write + fsync beside the path), then `os.Link(old, bad)` (a link cannot overwrite), then rename the replacement over the path: at every instant the path holds the old unreadable file or the new one. A failure anywhere changes nothing and leaves the block standing for the next boot. Owner-action replies report `persisted` (live vs on disk). A remedy text names only a remedy that survives the next write (the ack).
- **Reference:** `internal/datatruth/checks/fillprice.go` (`EnableState`, `freeBadName`, `installReplacing`, `snapshotLocked`, `AckDurable`), `api/handler_fillprice.go`. Pins: `TestInstallReplacingKeepsTheOldFileAtThePathUntilTheBadNameIsSecured`, `TestFillGuardUnreadableStateWriteFailureLeavesTheBlockStandingAtTheNextBoot`, `TestFillPriceUnreadableStateInstallFailureStillBlocksTheNextBoot`, `TestAckDurableIsFalseWhenTheStateWriteStalls`, `TestHandleAckFillPriceReportsWhetherTheAckReachedTheDisk`, and (round 4 review) `TestAckDurableIsFalseWhenTheStateWriteFails` + `TestHandleAckFillPriceReportsFalseWhenTheStateWriteFails` (a write that ERRORS, not only stalls) and `TestFillGuardUnreadableStateWhoseLinkFailsIsNeverWrittenOver` (the link step fails while the temp write works).
- **Second rule (round 4 review):** an owner-action reply's `persisted` is the WRITER'S RESULT - the newest written snapshot sequence is at least the ack's - never writer idleness: `Flush` also returns true for a write that failed loudly. And every `noPersist` branch needs its own pin through the production entry, since removing it silently turns "never overwrite an unreadable file" into an overwrite.
- **Known limits (not fixed):** a kill -9 inside the async-writer window after a strike forgets that strike (the exit is the priority, m55r3); a stalled disk leaves later snapshots queued behind the stuck write.

## release #55 round 3, builder h3 (class number assigned at merge) — a window sized by "N minus what the newer series holds"; an owner text that claims more, less or something else than the code does
- **Symptom:** (1) `stitchedBarRows` read the older 1m with `dataTruthStore1mN - len(r1)` while the 5m got a full window; `len(r1)` counts the new contract's replay rows that `rowsAfter` then drops, so after a roll the stitched 5m began ~3 sessions BEFORE the stitched 1m. `JudgeSwing4h` saw those early buckets as "N missing from the 1m" (they sit outside the 1m window, nothing is lost), repaired the line from the 5m, and the two EMA lines seeded from different buckets: the seed residual read as a 1.4 pt disagreement and SWING4H paused ~2 trading days after every roll. (2) The owner texts: `/api/health` and the banner called every data-truth pause `all_entries` (mentor-only, AI-only and one-account pauses included); a scope that WIDENED inside an open episode pushed nothing (the first push stayed labelled "(mentor traders)"); a pause of 99-240 min ended in silence; `fill_price` promised "entries resume automatically" while it only ends on an acknowledgement; its remedy was a bare relative `POST /api/risk/ack-fill-price` (no host, no login); a third far fill read "3 of 2 (the 2nd pauses ...)"; `ingest_loss` printed UTC and no way out. (3) Two production wirings survived deletion with every suite green: `RegisterBrokerTruthChecks()` in `doWireDataTruthBoot` (broker_agreement and fill_price stay "not wired" stubs -> every NT8 trader's entries block once the grace ends) and `trader.SetFillPriceStatePath(...)` in `main.go`.
- **Probe:** (a) for every pair of frames a check compares, assert STRUCTURALLY that the second never reaches before the first (`stitched m5[0].T >= m1[0].T`), then drive a strong-reversal tape - a quiet tape hides a seed residual; (b) for every owner-facing scope word ("all entries", "resume automatically", a URL), grep the code path that applies it and drive `handleHealth`/`Evaluate` with a reader-scoped and an account-scoped check; (c) copy-paste each remedy into a shell as written: it must name a host, a login and a header; (d) delete each boot call (`RegisterBrokerTruthChecks`, `SetFillPriceStatePath`) and run the package.
- **Rule:** a window is sized by its own full N, never by N minus what another series already holds, and a derived frame is trimmed to the reach of the series it is compared with (`rowsFrom`); a banner/health scope is computed per check from the readers and scopes the gate obeys (`DataTruthPausedScope`), never a constant; a scope growth inside an open episode is pushed once, deduped on the new scope; an ended pause is pushed once after the merge window; a check that ends only by an owner action says so (`SetResumeNote`); every remedy is runnable as written.
- **Pins (mutant RED each):** `TestStitchedFiveMinuteNeverReachesBeforeTheOneMinute`, `TestSwing4hDoesNotPauseAfterARollOnAReversalTape` (trader/ninjatrader), `TestDoWireDataTruthBootRegistersTheTwoAccountChecksForReal`, `TestRegisterFillPriceSetsTheAcknowledgementAddressFromTheConfig` (trader), `TestMainSetsTheFillPriceStatePathBeforeTradersLoad` (main), `TestHealthDataTruthScopeFollowsTheReadersAndAccounts` (api), `TestR3Widening...`, `TestR3TraderJoining...`, `TestR3ClearIsPushed...`, `TestR3ResumeNote...` (internal/datatruth), `TestR3FarFillAlert...`, `TestR3FillPricePauseText...`, `TestR3IngestLossReason...` (checks), `TestLedgerRingBarsMatchesTheBarCacheRing` (provider), banner tests in `DataPausedBanner.test.tsx`.
- **Reference:** `trader/ninjatrader/datatruth_boot.go` (`stitchedBarRows`, `rowsFrom`), `internal/datatruth/datatruth.go` (`hwWidens`, `scopeNote`, `SetResumeNote`, `Snapshot.Readers`), `trader/ninjatrader/bar_integrity.go` (`DataTruthPausedScope`, `PausedScopeAI`, `PausedScopeTraders`), `internal/datatruth/checks/{fillprice.go,ingestloss.go}`, `trader/fill_price_wire.go`, `api/handler_health.go`, `web/src/components/common/DataPausedBanner.tsx`.
