## release #55 round 4, builder h3 (class number assigned at merge) — a size cap enforced on ONE part of a message loses whichever part the cap cuts first; and a text can describe the block it was written for, not the one that stands
- **Symptom:** (1) the owner push (600-rune filter, `ownerpush.Scrub`) was composed by clipping only the DETAIL (floor 40 runes): a header that named three or more accounts, or a WIDENED header carrying the new AND the old scope, pushed the total over 600 and Scrub cut the END - the login/acknowledge steps and the resume note, the only part the owner acts on. The round-3 pin sent two accounts (590 runes) and passed. (2) A clipped detail can end inside a path: Scrub redacts a path wherever it stands and the stub read `/tmp/[redacted]`. (3) The generic push tail "entries resume automatically when the data measures clear" was appended to the unreadable-fill_price block (which a new session does not lift) and to the spent-budget ingest_loss pause (which needs the ring's age or a restart). (4) "UNREADABLE ... at the last restart" named the wrong restart after the second one; an acknowledgement on a block whose file could not be moved aside does not outlive a restart and the text did not say so; "restore a repaired copy" failed once a strike or ack had rewritten the file. (Merged with m55r4 h2: the repaired-copy remedy is DROPPED from the pause text and the guide - the acknowledgement is the only remedy named, since the next write undoes a swapped file.) (5) A data-truth block for the MENTOR readers next to a SWING4H block read "mentor traders only; AI/planner entries trade normally" while SWING4H (an AI-side entry) was paused. (6) The dashboard banner named the failed checks and no way out.
- **Probe:** for every capped message, sweep the LENGTH of every part (head 0..900, detail 0..1200, tail 0..cap) and assert total <= cap AND the tail intact; for every push, run the REAL text through the real filter (`ownerpush.Scrub`) and assert `Scrub(x) == x`; for every "how entries come back" sentence, ask which block it is attached to and whether that block's exit is the one named.
- **Rule:** `composePush` always lands at or under `PushRunes` and sacrifices in a fixed order - detail (clipped at a word, never inside a path), detail dropped, header clipped, only a tail longer than the cap itself; the tail (remedy) is last. Scope lists in a push header are capped at two names plus "and N more" (full list in the log line and `/api/health`). A tail's length does not grow with the data (fillResume names "<ACCOUNT>, once for each paused account"). The resume note is per check and per standing block (`FillGuard.resume`: unreadable-state tail vs strike tail; `IngestLossResume`). Paths come LAST in a detail. A mentor-reader data-truth block next to the swing line check is `mixed_entries`.
- **Pins (mutant RED each):** `TestComposePushNeverExceedsTheCapAndNeverClipsTheTail` (old body), `TestPushHeaderCapsTheNamedScopes` (pushNames = 0), `TestR4FillPricePushesSurviveScrubForEveryNumberOfAccounts` (1..8 accounts, open + every WIDENED push, through `RegisterFillPrice` + `datatruth.Evaluate` + `ownerpush.Scrub`; old composePush), `TestR4UnreadableStateTextsAreHonestAndSurviveScrub` (the strike tail on the unreadable block), `TestR4IngestLossTextsAreHonestAboutTheWayOut` (production `RegisterAll`; drop the ingest_loss `SetResumeNote`), `TestHealthMentorOnlyDataTruthBlockNextToSwing4hIsMixedNotMentor` (the dtMentor branch), `TestStitchedOneMinuteIsAFullWindowAfterARoll` (the older 1m read as N minus the replay overlap, on its own, without the trim), web `DataPausedBanner.test.tsx` "fill_price and ingest_loss pauses show their remedy on screen" (no remedy push), `TestDoWireDataTruthBootRegistersTheTwoAccountChecksForReal` (delete `RegisterBrokerTruthChecks()` from `doWireDataTruthBoot`).
- **Reference:** `internal/datatruth/datatruth.go` (`composePush`, `clipAtWord`, `scopeNoteMax`, `pushNames`, `ComposePush`), `internal/datatruth/checks/fillprice.go` (`fillResume`, `unreadableResume`, `FillGuard.resume`, `describe`, `errCause`), `internal/datatruth/checks/ingestloss.go` (`ingestLossRemedy`, `IngestLossResume`), `api/handler_health.go` (`dtMentor`), `trader/ninjatrader/bar_integrity.go` (`WidestPausedScope`), `trader/ninjatrader/datatruth_boot.go` (`stitchedBarRows`), `web/src/components/common/DataPausedBanner.tsx`.
- **Evidence tier:** [A] swing roll: the reviewer's simulated 12-26 -> 03-27 roll (`TestRV55J3Roll`, RV_MODE=roll_sim, roll at 10-13 17:00 and 10-20 17:00, corpus `roll_real.json.gz`) shows 0 of 36 and 0 of 21 evaluations with SWING4H blocked after the fix (the reviewer's run blocked at 10-15 08:00, 1.32 pt > 1.00 pt); the one `indicator_lookback_session` block at 10-20 08:00 is the real corpus's own missing-volume VWAP shift, identical on the base.
- **Known limits (not fixed):** the push header drops the second and later account names (they are in the log line and `/api/health`); `GUIDE_BUILT_REV` is not bumped here (the integrator bumps it to the shipped rev); the IPv6 `APIServerHost` edge prints a malformed URL (default 127.0.0.1).

## wave fix/m457-pep-core (class number assigned at merge) — a plan's one-line summary of a spec is a second copy of it; a row labelled with a convention it does not follow; two writers, one guard
- **Symptom:** (1) The pep plan said style E uses "the same box" as style A (5 minutes). The owner's PDF ledger says otherwise: every style-E row's target equals the high-low of the FIRST TWO minutes (2025-10-20: 73.0 pts = the 08:30+08:31 bars; style-A box 86.75), and 87 of 89 comparable days then match to the dollar. Built from the plan, E would have traded a different box on every day. (2) All 1.39M `historical_import` 1m rows say `convention=epoch_floor` but are CLOSE-stamped: an import row at T is identical (OHLCV) to the live row at T-60000. Any consumer that trusts the column reads every bar one minute late. (3) A backtest that fills a stop on a mere TOUCH disagreed with the PDF on 2026-03-25 (style E): the bar's high equalled the stop to the tick and the PDF books the target; trade-THROUGH reproduces it. (4) A new mode that must exclude two others (mentor, day plan) can be guarded in the HTTP handler and bypassed by every other writer of the strategies table (agent tools, repair commands).
- **Probe:** for every number a plan/brief states about an external source, derive the same number from the source's OWN rows (here: implied box = |gross| / (contracts x point value)) before building. For every stored bar convention, find rows that exist twice and diff them. For every fill rule in a backtest, find a day where a bar touches a level exactly and compare with the reference. For every "exactly one of" rule, list the writers of the row and put the guard at the choke they share.
- **Rule:** the per-style box length is a setting (A 5, E 2); the backtest shifts `historical_import` rows -60 s itself and says so; fill convention is a flag (`-stop-through`, default ON = the PDF engine) and the report names the one in force; mode exclusivity is enforced in `StrategyStore.Create/Update/*WithExplicitZeros` (`guardStrategyModes`) AND pre-checked in the API for a clean 400 (`TradingModeConflict`).
- **Pins:** `TestE_StopRoundsOutward`, `TestSLRoundingSetting`, `TestE_EMAIsNeverResetDaily`, `TestReplay_StopThroughConvention`, `TestReplay_A_TPandSL` (same-bar stop first), `TestTradingModeConflict`, `TestStrategyStoreWritersRefuseModeConflict`, `TestPepWithMentorOrDayPlanIsRefusedByName`, `TestPepBlockRoundTrips`, `TestPepLeavesRegisteredExactlyAndUnique`, `TestDefaultConfigEqualsResolvedStoreDefaults`, `TestLoadSeriesShiftsImportsAndIsReadOnly` (cmd/pep-backtest), web `pepGuide.test.ts`. Review round 2 (every number is a setting means the REPORT reads it too): `TestRenderFeesFollowTheFeeSetting` (the backtest summary hardcoded `traded*6`/`*3`, so changing pep_fee_per_contract_usd moved nothing), `TestEvaluate_StaleFeedBoundaryIsExact` (lag == limit is fresh), `TestE_WarmupBoundaryIsExact` (N vs N+1 candles), `TestE_ShortCrossFromExactlyTheBoxLow` (spec: from >= box low). Each was shown RED against its mutant (`lag >= maxAge`, `i < warm-1`, `pr > box.Low`, a constant 1.0 fee). Review round 3 (a boundary the real-data backtest cannot see needs a unit pin): `TestE_SignalAgeBoundaryIsExact` (E age == limit is fresh; kills `age >= limit`), `TestE_BoxCompletingCandleMayFire` (the 08:30-08:32 candle may fire; the per-day CSV is identical for both, only this pin separates them; kills `c.End <= box.End`), `TestTPRoundsToNearestTick` (target to the NEAREST tick in both stop-rounding modes; with the shipped 1.0 fraction on a tick-snapped box it is a no-op; kills RoundTick -> CeilTick in either branch of `distances`). Each shown RED via `go test -overlay` at TZ unset and UTC.
- **Reference:** `kernel/pep/`, `store/pep.go`, `store/knob_registry_pep.go`, `cmd/pep-backtest/`, `/home/hoang/fleet-1017/out/pep-backtest-vs-pdf.md`.
- **Known limits (not fixed):** the stored `historical_import` rows are still mislabelled (fixing the data is its own job: back up first, owner go); mentor key levels built from them may be one minute off; three style-E days (2025-11-04, 2026-03-16, 2026-04-10) trade here and have no row in the PDF (EMA crosses within 0.4-3 pts of an edge), one style-A day (2026-02-10) likewise, unexplained.

## wave fix/m459-pep-ui (class number assigned at merge) — a new root config block that one load/save path forgets; two UI writers for one exclusive choice; "off" and "unknown" drawn the same; a merge that keeps absent keys
- **Symptom:** (1) A new ROOT block on `StrategyConfig` (`pep`) is silently dropped by the Studio unless `normalizeStrategyConfig` lists it: the editor loads without it, the Save sends without it, the toast fires on HTTP 200 and the UI looks fine. (2) The Studio had ONE writer of `mentor_mode` (the switch inside Risk Control); adding a Trading-mode selector made TWO, and the old switch could turn mentor ON while pep stayed ON - the combination the server refuses. (3) A dashboard mode chip that prints "AI" whenever neither truth says "enabled" prints "AI" while the pep answer is still loading or failed. (4) `PUT /api/strategies/:id` deep-merges and keeps absent keys, so a "blank = default" field cannot clear a stored pep number. (5) The save path threw `save failed (HTTP 400)` and discarded the server's named conflict (`pep_mode_conflict_*`).
- **Probe:** for every new root block, drive the REAL page (`StrategyStudioPage`) with a mocked network and read the PUT body: load a stored block, change an unrelated field, save, assert the block is in the body. For every exclusive choice, list EVERY writer of every flag involved (grep the flag) and assert each writer routes through the one function. For every status chip, ask what it prints while the source is loading and when it failed. For every field the server merges, assert the Studio sends a concrete value for every leaf. For every non-OK save, assert the named server error reaches the screen.
- **Rule:** the root block is listed in `normalizeStrategyConfig` and a page-level test pins load -> save; `applyTradingMode` is the ONE writer of `mentor_mode` + `pep.pep_enabled` and the mentor switch inside Risk Control routes through it (`onMentorModeChange`); the mode chip names a mode only when both truths have answered (`dashboardMode`); every pep edit and every Save sends the FULL block (`fullPepBlock`: a concrete value per registered leaf, a legal 0 kept); a refused save shows the server's named conflict.
- **Pins (mutant RED each):** `StrategyStudioPage.pep.test.tsx` (`a stored pep block survives load and save`, `Mentor ON then Pep ON ... exactly one mode`, `the mentor switch inside Risk Control turns pep OFF`, `Save always sends the FULL pep block`, `a server-refused save names the mode conflict`), `pepModel.test.ts` (`both-ON is unreachable` over every start x target, `fullPepBlock` carries every registered leaf), `PepModePanel.test.tsx` (`an edit sends the WHOLE pep block`, `a stored PARTIAL block is completed`), `TradingModeSelector.test.tsx` (`Pep asks first`, `cannot be chosen while the Day Plan is ON`), `TraderDashboardPage.pep.test.tsx` (`mode chip ... only when the truths have answered`, `draws the box ... through the price-line channel`, `draws NO box line while the box is not drawn yet`), `pepGuide.test.ts` (cards vs `PEP_FIELDS` vs the Go resolver vs the knob registry), `pepGateLabels.test.ts` (every `kernel/pep` refusal code has a gate label).
- **Reference:** `web/src/components/strategy/{pepModel.ts,PepModePanel.tsx,TradingModeSelector.tsx}`, `web/src/pages/StrategyStudioPage.tsx` (`normalizeStrategyConfig`, `setTradingMode`, Save), `web/src/components/pep/`, `web/src/guide/content/pep.ts`, `web/src/i18n/pep-translations.ts`.
- **Known limits (not fixed):** `GET /api/traders/:id/pep-truth` did not exist when this wave was cut; `PepTruth` in `web/src/lib/api/traders.ts` is defined from `kernel/pep` types and must be matched by (or replaced in the same merge as) the trader lane's handler, which must answer `{enabled:false}` (not 404) when pep is off or the chip reads "unknown"; the pep gate-block counter names the trader lane emits are not known yet (the panel labels every `kernel/pep` refusal code); the not-applied caveat under break-even/trailing is rendered only if the trader lane's effective origin contains `pep_enabled on ... not used`; the Studio strategy panels still carry zh/en/es copy while the UI languages are en/zh/id (pep copy is en/zh/id; the older panels' gap is not widened).

### wave fix/m459-pep-ui, review round 1 (class number assigned at merge) — a UI type written against an endpoint that did not exist yet, and tests that feed the UI its own invented JSON
- **Symptom:** the Pep card, the box lines on the chart and the mode chip were built against a PROVISIONAL `PepTruth` (`signal:{state,side}`, `flat_in_sec`, `as_of_ms`, `symbol`). The trader lane then shipped the real handler (`trader/pep_truth.go`): `signal` is a plain string word, the countdown is `flat_countdown_sec`, the time is `last_evaluated_ms`, and there is no `symbol`. Rendered with the real JSON the card read "Signal -", showed no countdown and no time, and `pepSymbol` was undefined so the box was never drawn on any tab. Every UI test was green, because every fixture was the UI's own shape. Also: six trader-side gate counters had no `GATE_LABELS` entry (raw keys on the gate panel, and the guide's "every human label (N)" count wrong); the Studio's UI-only floors (fraction 0.05, tick 0.01) contradicted a comment and a guide card that said "the SAME bounds as the Go resolver / greater than 0"; and the Day Plan block gave no warning that Pep ON makes the plan un-enableable (the guard existed in one direction only).
- **Probe:** for every endpoint the UI reads, find the Go struct that emits it and diff the json tags against the TS type BEFORE writing a fixture. Every UI test for a server payload must parse a golden of the bytes Go emits (non-omitempty fields always present, omitempty only when set), never a literal typed in the TS shape. For every counter the server increments, grep the panel's label table. For every comment or guide line that says "same bounds", read both bounds. For every pair of mutually exclusive switches, check the guard exists in BOTH directions and that "turn it OFF" is never blocked.
- **Rule:** `pepTruthGolden.ts` holds the Go-emitted JSON and the card, the chart-line builder and the chip are tested through it; `pepTruthContract.test.ts` reads `trader/pep_truth.go` the moment it is in the tree and fails if a key the UI reads is not a json tag there (today that is `symbol`, which the trader lane must add: `Symbol string json:"symbol,omitempty"` set from `at.futuresSymbol()`) or if the Go signal words differ from the card's table; `pepGateLabels.test.ts` lists every trader counter and, at integration, scans `trader/pep_*.go` for the rest; `dashboardMode` reads server `mode:"conflict"` and mentor+pep ON before it picks a mode; the Day Plan editor refuses to turn the plan ON under Pep but always lets it turn OFF.
- **Pins (mutant RED each):** `pep.test.tsx` (`the server signal WORD reads as text`, `the countdown comes from flat_countdown_sec`, `the as-of time is last_evaluated_ms`, `mentor AND pep ON, or the server mode "conflict", is a conflict`, `a mode conflict is a loud alert`), `TraderDashboardPage.pep.test.tsx` (`the server JSON as sent today (no symbol)`, `a mentor+pep conflict reads as a conflict chip`), `pepTruthContract.test.ts`, `pepGateLabels.test.ts`, `pepGuide.test.ts` (`every range text carries the Go bound`: the two UI floors are stated), `DayPlanEditor.pep.test.tsx` (refuses ON, repairs a both-ON state, no warning without Pep), `StrategyStudioPage.pep.test.tsx` (`with Pep ON the Day Plan block warns before Save`), `PepModePanel.test.tsx` (`a stored lowercase style "e" shows as E`).
- **Reference:** `web/src/lib/api/traders.ts` (`PepTruth`), `web/src/components/pep/`, `web/src/components/plan/GateBlocksPanel.tsx`, `web/src/components/strategy/DayPlanEditor.tsx`, the trader lane's `trader/pep_truth.go`, `api/handler_pep_truth.go`.
- **Known limits (not fixed):** the integration merge must (1) add `symbol` to the Go `PepTruth` (the contract test is RED until then, deliberately), (2) dedupe the duplicate `pep_*` keys in `GATE_LABELS` (the trader branch added its own block in the same object literal; keep one, then re-run `guideTruth.test.ts`, which pins the status.ts count of 108), (3) update the "Build status of this page" callout in `guide/content/pep.ts`. Merging this UI before the trader wave lets the owner turn Pep ON with no order path (the callout says so).
